summary: minimal braiding hardware: 3 junctions -> single-qutrit Clifford (B_3->SL(2,3)=2T); 4 junctions -> full Sp(4,3). Transvections = elementary braids; the hardware graph must host them; photoelectric hinge gives the electron/photon carrier choice.
sources: symplectic transvections generate Sp(2n,q); braid/commute relations from the form value (Artin/Steinberg)
